critical_changes: C1: Align headline claims with the tables. The abstract's 'this would remain true for a generator that reproduced each painter exactly' is contradicted by the faithful CSD value of 48.3% for GPT Image 2 (Table 2). Replace 'only a few points higher'/'within a few points' with the actual deltas (CLIP -2.8 to +3.2; CSD +2.0 to +6.6; GPT Image 2 CLIP is below faithful). Scope 'for related painters' to these four painters unless a second painter set is added.

C2: Restate or remove 'Texture is the least shared feature family' (intro bullet 5, Section 5.5 heading). Per Table 6 it holds in only 3 of 6 configurations, and texture is the most shared family for Nano Banana 2 and Sunburst. Report per-configuration orderings and the cross-configuration mean (texture 68.2 vs spatial 71.5 vs color 74.3) with uncertainty. Keep the SD-Turbo texture result.

C3: Add scene-bootstrap and reference-resampling intervals for observed-minus-faithful differences (Table 1 and both halves of Table 2), and qualify Figure 3's 'below the faithful value in every configuration and representation', especially FLUX.2 Max (88.4 vs 90.4, deletion range up to 90.2).

C4: Make the specificity readout operational. State that GPT Image 1, Flare and Sunburst have reference-resampling D intervals entirely above the no-distinction value of 1. Relate observed D to the genuine-painting controls (0.234 pooled, 0.753 within content classes, vs FLUX.2 Max 0.801). In Section 6, specify which between-name statistics (beta, beta/sqrt(Q), D or D_agg, per-pair) practitioners should report and how to read disagreements among them.

C5: Fix internal inconsistencies: the development panel 'never compared with generated images' (Section 3) vs its use as a reference target (Section 5.2, App. F); 'more than twice the reference size' for Q (Section 5.3, App. D), which is a squared-size ratio (about 1.49x in norm); 'regenerates every table and figure' (App. H, Reproducibility statement), although Figures 2 and 4 are static hash-checked copies and Figure 1 is a schematic; 'independent generations' (intro) vs the concession in Limitations.

C6: Support the opening claim 'Artist-style prompting is often evaluated by how much closer images ... move to that artist's works' with specific published evaluations that report proximity/similarity-to-artist scores, stating which quantity each uses.

C7: Clarity edit. Rewrite the ambiguous sentences quoted in W-B1 (e.g., 'Zero error is not attainable either.'; 'These differences have a common explanation, which follows from Equation 4 for proximity and is an interpretation for the other two readouts.'; 'Some benchmark values were first computed during internal review of an earlier draft; the analysis plan records this.'). Explain the App. C scenario in which coverage drops to 0.04% and its relevance to closed services. Reduce the number density of Sections 5.3-5.4 by moving secondary values to tables.

Consider an observed-minus-faithful difference plot with intervals in place of or alongside Figure 3, where the FLUX.2 Max markers overlap.
Replace or explain the Commons:GLAM citation as the source for the reference records.
Note whether gpt-image-2.5-flare/-sunburst are preview or stealth endpoints, for replicability.
Release the generated images via an anonymized host or downsampled JPEGs within the 100 MB supplement limit.

factual_errors: Abstract (p.1): 'this would remain true for a generator that reproduced each painter exactly' is false for GPT Image 2 in CSD, whose faithful shared part of proximity gain is 48.3% (Table 2; the abstract's own range is 48.3-75.7%).
Section 5.2 (p.8): 'the observed shares are only a few points higher' is false for GPT Image 2 in CLIP (observed 73.2 < faithful 76.0); CSD differences reach 6.6 points (FLUX.2 Max 77.6 vs 71.0).

Intro bullet 5 (p.2) and Section 5.5 heading (p.10): 'Texture is the least shared feature family' holds in only 3 of 6 main configurations (Table 6); spatial is least for GPT Image 2 and Sunburst, color for Nano Banana 2, and texture is the most shared family for Nano Banana 2 (79.8) and Sunburst (70.3).

Section 3 (p.4) says the development panel 'is never compared with generated images', but Section 5.2 (p.8) uses 'the development panel as the reference target' and App. F refers to four source-view/reference-target combinations.

Section 5.3 (p.9) 'its differences are more than twice the reference size, Q = 2.223' and App. D (p.19) 'about twice the reference size': Q is a squared-size ratio; in norm the differences are about 1.49x the reference.

Appendix H (p.23) and the Reproducibility statement (p.12) claim every table and figure is regenerated byte for byte; per figures/PROVENANCE.json, Figures 2 and 4 are static hash-checked copies with retired builders, and Figure 1 is a schematic that App. H nonetheless calls 'generated from those result files'.
